<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { SliderRange, SliderRoot, SliderThumb, SliderTrack } from 'reka-ui';

const value = defineModel<number>('value', { default: 25 });

const values = computed({
  get: () => [value.value],
  set: (next: number[] | undefined) => {
    value.value = next?.[0] ?? value.value;
  }
});
</script>

<template>
  <SliderRoot :min="0" :max="100" :step="1" class="research-slider" v-model="values">
    <SliderTrack class="research-slider__track" />
    <SliderRange class="research-slider__range" />
    <SliderThumb class="research-slider__thumb" />
  </SliderRoot>
</template>

<style scoped>
.research-slider { box-sizing: border-box; width: 200px; height: 32px; position: relative; display: block; }
.research-slider .research-slider__track { box-sizing: border-box; width: 200px; height: 16px; position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; }
.research-slider .research-slider__range { box-sizing: border-box; height: 16px; position: absolute; top: 0px; }
.research-slider .research-slider__thumb { box-sizing: border-box; width: 16px; height: 16px; position: absolute; top: 0px; }
</style>
